Step response shows lag/first-order-like delay: settling takes tens to hundreds of seconds, several times any initial delay.
No large dead zone: even small u > 0.1 produces a measurable rise above the u=0 trajectory.
At u=0, y decays on its own toward room ambient near or below 0.24.
Steady-state y is approximately linear in u across 0 to 1.
The steady-state input needed to hold y=0.5 is moderate, in range 0.3-0.7.
Sensor noise is small (short-term fluctuations <0.01) so trends and end slopes are interpretable.
